parameters.query:
SELECT g.id AS guest_id, g.party_id, g.role, g.status, p.status AS party_status
FROM guests g
JOIN parties p ON p.id = g.party_id
WHERE g.join_token = $1
  AND g.role = 'host'
  AND g.status = 'active'
  AND p.status = 'active'
LIMIT 1

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return [{ json: { items: rows, count: rows.length } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={ "error": "unauthorized", "message": "Invalid host token or party not active" }
